scenario: AUTO: holding a pad plays a pattern on its root, starting and stopping the song
name: companion: BASS AUTO (Latin, tresillo) in C major: holding the I pad (F3) starts the song and plays C3; letting go stops it; the ii pad (G3) plays D3
note: With every sound's own effects (D-094) a note's echo and reverb ring on after it ends: what follows waits for them (0.8 s).
